text.p: Dutch building firm NBM-Amstelland said on Thursday it expected to see further growth in earnings per share in 1997.
Earlier, the firm reported 1996 net profits of 81.5 million guilders versus a year-earlier 40.8 million. Profits per ordinary share rose to 2.85 guilders from 2.38.

"It is expected that turnover will increase slightly, with a concurrent improvement in the net profit margin. After deduction of the preference dividend, a continued growth in the profit per ordinary share is expected," the firm said in a statement.
"The outlook in the different markets in which the firm is active, are not unfavourable," it added. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
